content: Aaron wiahda Meirong kei
Ni rahn mwurin kasarawihpen kesepwildao eh imwiseklahr, Moses ahpw ekerodo Aaron oh nah pwutak ko, iangahki kaunen mehn Israel ko.

E ahpw patohwanohng Aaron, “Ale emen kouwol pwul oh emen sihpw wol me sohte kisin samin kis rehra oh meirongkihong KAUN-O, kouwolo pahn wia mehn meirong en dihp oh sihpw wolo pahn wia mehn meirong isihs.

Ke pahn pil ndaiong mehn Israel kan re en wahdo emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp, emen kouwol me mahki sounpar ehu, oh emen sihmpwul me pil mahki sounpar ehu me sohte kisin samin kis reh, mahn pwukat pahn wia mehn meirong isihs,

oh pil emen kouwol oh emen sihpw wol mehn wia meirong en kaminimin. Irail en meirongkihong KAUN-O mahn pwukat koaros iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw me doal leh. Re pahn wia met pwe KAUN-O pahn ketin pwarohng irail rahnwet.’”
Irail eri wapene mwohn wenihmwen Impwalo mehkoaros me Moses patohwanohng irail oh pokon en mehn Israel ko ahpw patopene wasao pwe re en kaudokiong KAUN-O.
Moses ahpw patohwanohng irail, “KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong kumwail en wia met, pwe sapwellime lingaling en pwarohng kumwail.”

Ih eri patohwanohng Aaron, “Kohwei ni pei sarawio oh wiahda meirong en dihp oh meirong isihs pwehn wia lapwepen dipomw kan oh dipen aramas akan, ke pahn wia meirong wet pwe dipen aramas akan en lapwada, nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanih.”
Aaron eri patohla ni pei sarawio oh kemehla koupwul wol men mehn wia meirong en dipe.
Nah pwutak ko ahpw patohwandohng ntahn kouo, ih eri kaduh sendinpeh nan ntao oh iriski koden keimw pahieu en pei sarawio oh wudekihdiong luhwen ntao ni poahsoan en pei sarawio.
Mwuri e ahpw isikala wih en mahno pohn pei sarawio, iangahki mwidihlik ko oh wasa keieu mwahu en eho, nin duwen KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong Moses.
Ahpw udukeo oh kilio e isikala likin kahnimpwalo.
Aaron pil kemehla mahn me wia eh meirong isihs. Nah pwutak ko pil patohwandohng ntao, e ahpw wudekihdiong ni pengepenge pahieu koaros en pei sarawio.
Irail pil kihong moangeo oh wasa teikan en mahno, e ahpw isikala pohn pei sarawio.
Mwuri e kamwakelehda kepwehn loale kan oh neh ko, oh isikala pohn meirong isihso me mi pohn pei sarawio.
Mwurin mepwukat e ahpw patohwanda en aramas ako ar meirong. E ale kuht mehn wia meirong en dipen aramas ako oh kemehla. E ahpw meirongki duwehte me e wiahiong eh mehn meirong en dipeo.
E pil ale; mahno mehn wia meirong isihs oh meirongkihla nin duwen kosonnedo.
E patohwanda meirong en wahnsahpw wet, e ale oaroahr en pilawa ehu oh isikala pohn pei sarawio. (Met kin patehng meirong isihs en rahn koaros.)
E kemehla kouwolo oh sihpw wolo pwehn wia meirong en kaminimin en aramas akan. Nah pwutak ko patohwandohng ntao, e ahpw wudekihdiong ni pengepenge pahieu koaros en pei sarawio.
Aaron ahpw kihong wih en kouwolo oh sihpw wolo
pohn mwaremwaren mahn ako oh wahla koaros pohn pei sarawio. E ahpw isikala wih ko pohn pei sarawio,
oh patohwandohng pweisen samworo kan mwaremwar ko oh neh palimaun kan nin duwen kisakis tohrohr ehu ong KAUN-O, nin duwen me Moses koasoanehdi.
Ni Aaron eh kaimwisekala meirong koaros, e ahpw patohwanda peh ko pohn aramas koaros oh kupwuramwahwihirailla. E ahpw patohdi sang wasao.
Moses oh Aaron ahpw patohlongala nan Impwalen KAUN-O. Ni ara pwureisang loale, ira ahpw kupwuramwahwih aramas ako. Lingaling en KAUN-O ahpw pwarada mwohn aramas ako koaros.
KAUN-O eri mwadangete kadarala kisiniei oh isikala meirong isihso oh luhwen wih ko me mi pohn pei sarawio. Ni aramas ako ar kilangada irair wet, koaruhsie ahpw weriwer oh poaridiong nanpwel.
